description: Score the readability of the page against WCAG contrast rules. Walks the visible text, resolves each run’s foreground against the real background painted behind it — blending translucent layers up the ancestor chain — and reports the ratio, the ratio the level requires, and whether it passes. The score is the share of sampled text runs that pass, so it is directly comparable before and after page.applyTheme.

level.description: WCAG level: AA needs 4.5:1 for body text and 3:1 for large text, AAA needs 7:1 and 4.5:1

maxFailures.description: Failures listed, worst ratio first; the counts always cover everything sampled

maxSamples.description: Text-bearing elements to check, in document order

target.description: Subtree to audit; defaults to the whole page

nth.description: Zero-based index when several elements match

role.description: Tag name or ARIA role to narrow matches, e.g. "button" or "link"

text.description: Case-insensitive visible text the element should contain

name: page_auditContrast
